prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: illustrated app-store promotional cover, 1280 by 960 pixels, landscape 4:3. Create an original polished pixel-art cover for Open Dungeon, a small turn-based procedural dungeon game. Show an isometric arrangement of dark stone dungeon rooms with warm torch light, a lone simple adventurer carrying a sword standing near stairs, a treasure chest and a few small monsters deeper in the corridors. Strong clear composition readable at thumbnail size, restrained teal shadows and amber highlights, charming compact pixel shapes. This is a promotional illustration, not a screenshot; do not draw a fake interface, buttons, device, HUD or performance counters. Text only: OPEN DUNGEON in a carefully rendered pixel title along the upper part. Do not use any existing game logos or recognizable copyrighted characters. Full rectangular image, no rounded corners, no watermark.
icon: Original geometric SVG rendered with rsvg-convert; assets/icon.svg is the editable source.
